newsitem.title: USA: Comstock development well in production.
newsitem.headline: Comstock development well in production.

text.p: Comstock Resources Inc said Monday an infill development well drilled in the Double A Wells field in Polk County, Texas, is producing 10,140 thousand cubic feet of natural gas and 960 barrels of condensate per day without stimulation.

Comstock said the Alabama-Coushatta No. 8 well was drilled to a depth of 14,651 feet and completed in the Upper Woodbine formation through perforations at 14,535 feet to 14,596 feet. The company owns a 32 percent working interest and is the operator of the well.
Due to the excellent initial production performance, Comstock said, it has canceled plans to stimulate the well.

The company said it is also drilling the Carter-Battise No. 3 in the Double A Wells field. The well is currently drilling below 14,000 feet and should reach total depth in the near future. After the Carter-Battise No. 3, Comstock has plans to drill two Yegua wells as well as drill another Woodbine development well in the field in 1997.
